visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens on a solid black background with large yellow and white Chinese characters at the top, posing a strategic question. The "Arena of Valor" logo is centered with sharp, metallic textures and a glowing orange hue. (2) A sequence of static game character cards appears. A golden armored knight, a dark robotic figure with a glowing eye, and a round purple bat-like creature are shown in succession. Large red 'X' marks are superimposed over them one by one. (3) A four-panel grid shows a man painting a face onto his hand and chin in a humorous "low-cost cosplay" style. He has a neutral expression. Adjacent panels show polished anime character art of a man and a woman in pink and white outfits. (4) High-quality splash art of a female character with blue hair and fish-like ears (Dolia) appears. She is surrounded by stylized blue water and bubbles in a high-fantasy art style. The lighting is bright and ethereal. (5) Screen recording of gameplay shows the character Dolia in a top-down perspective. She moves through a lush green forest environment towards blue-tinted monsters. Blue circular ripples and wave effects appear as she uses skills against the targets. (6) Rapid clips from an anime show a blonde girl spinning as light ribbons wrap around her body, transitioning into a pink outfit. The background is filled with sparkles and pink hues, indicating a magical girl transformation sequence. (7) A final call-to-action screen appears with yellow text over the same anime background, encouraging likes and comments.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator with a friendly, professional tone speaks clearly over a high-tempo, energetic synth-pop background track. The BGM features a steady 4/4 electronic beat and bright synthesizer textures. Ambient noise is absent. (2) The narrator says "no no" several times, each instance accompanied by a distinct digital "pop" sound effect (SFX). The BGM continues smoothly, maintaining its energy. (3) The narrator's pitch rises as he enthusiastically introduces the character "Dolia." A subtle metallic "ding" emphasizes the name. The music remains upbeat. (4) As the explanation continues, a "whoosh" transition SFX marks the shift to gameplay. Sounds of water splashing and soft thuds from game impacts are layered under the narration. (5) The narrator's tone becomes more dramatic and questioning. Suddenly, a high-arousal female Japanese vocal track (J-pop) cuts in with a loud, festive intensity. (6) The vocal music continues as the narrator delivers a final call-to-action. The production quality is high, with a clear separation between the primary speech, SFX, and the multi-layered music bed.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to share a game strategy or 'meta' insight for the mobile game Arena of Valor, specifically highlighting the character Dolia's strength in invading the enemy jungle at level 1. It uses a humorous narrative style, incorporating low-cost cosplay memes and anime references (Mermaid Melody) to entertain and engage the gaming community.
